type10_tk_x.name: Type 10 (TK-X)
type10_tk_x.authority: Release 267 (owner 2026-10-31, "make that part of a japan new model line where we update the type 10b and type 10 tk-x a lot too"; Main 2026-10-31: one base, true size): the TRDI TK-X prototype (unveiled 2008, prototypes 99-0237 to 99-0240) on the modern Type 10 (profiles/type10X.ts) in its prototype forms, which TRDI's trial photographs and the change list of the prototype-to-production programme (Japanese Wikipedia, after Maru 2012) show: plain side blocks with seams and no stowage doors, four separate round smoke ports a side, the open basket fence, the muzzle mirror on the gun's upper left, and a trials rack behind the commander's sight. The production Type 10 print it was registered against until 267 is not the prototype and is deregistered (tools/procedural-fidelity.html).
type10_tk_x.envelopeBasis: The as-built envelope (Box3 at both qualities) of the modern Type 10 it draws: 9.42 m gun forward (the prototype placard and Gunji Kenkyu's table: 9.42 m), 3.389 m over the skirts (the modern Type 10's source width; the published 3.24 m conflict is recorded in docs/references/tanks/type10_x.md), 4.122 m to the whips' tips (the roof at 2.21 m, published 2.30 m).
